name: Approach a manipulation target
description: Park the base where the right arm has a collision-free IK solution at the target's reach pose: 10 cm above an object or support, the handle pre-grasp of a door or drawer, 8 cm in front of a button.

target.description: The object, support, handle-bearing part or button to reach.

pass_by.description: Optional base waypoint: reach toward the target while driving past it.

base_pose.description: Base pose at which reachability was verified.

precheck.name: base_near
precheck.meaning: Base centre within 1.3 m of the place's footprint (inside the room for a room).
precheck.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

verifier.name: reachable
verifier.meaning: From the current base pose the right TCP has a collision-free IK solution 10 cm above the target (handle pre-grasp for doors, 8 cm in front of a button).
verifier.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

policy_plan.selection: first path whose noun conditions all hold, decided before any motion
policy_plan.on_no_match: NO_PATH: the Contract refuses without moving

paths.note: Extend the arm toward the reach pose while the base follows the given waypoint.

includes: base pose search with IK + collision checks
